action: Re-engage the strongest of the three external employer contacts from the tick 6 follow-up calls. Of the three — regional logistics company, healthcare system risk division, municipal risk management office — reach out by phone to the contact who expressed the most genuine interest or left the conversation most open. Frame the contact around a specific, current development: the RoboRide residential delivery expansion and the resulting commercial fleet risk profile that is emerging in the region.
